Both a truck driver and a chemist had their bags searched at the airport. A drug-sniffing dog had signalled that officers should look into the bag of the truck driver and, sure enough, they found quite a bit of cocaine. After the chemist's bag was flagged and searched, though, they were let go as it was apparently just a false alarm. Who was free of drugs?
A. The chemist
B. The truck driver
C. Can't answer
